title: What It Was Like to be Every Peaky Blinder Rank
fullText: Level one, tag along. You're not in the gang. Not really, but you're close enough to feel like you are. You walk three steps behind the older boys. You keep your mouth shut. You watch everything. Who talks to who? Who owes what? Who gets nervous when a cop walks by. The men don't acknowledge you. That's fine. You're not here to be noticed. You're here to be seen with them. Nobody touches the kid who walks with the blinders. One of the older lads looks back at you. You still here? You nod. Good. That's all you get. But it's enough. It means they know your face. It means when things go wrong, you might be worth saving. You don't plan anything. You don't do anything. You just prove day after day that you won't fold. Someday they'll give you a job. Someday you'll matter. For now, you just follow. Level two. Look out. You've got one job and you'd better not mess it up. You stand at the corner or just outside the pub door. Wherever trouble shows up first, that's where they put you. Your eyes never stop moving. You're watching for uniforms, for unfamiliar faces, for anyone who walks a little too slow and looks a little too interested. A police whistle in the distance. Your heart jumps, but it's not coming this way. You exhale. The boys inside are counting money, making deals, doing things you're not supposed to know about. Your job is to make sure they have time to scatter if it goes bad. One whistle from you, that's the signal. You've never had to use it, and that's [music] a good thing. It means you're doing your job right. Hours pass, your feet ache, and it's freezing outside. But you don't move, and you don't complain. Because if something happens and you're not paying attention, [music] you're done. And not just with the gang. Done. Done. Level three. Runner. Notes, cash, small packages. You move them fast and you don't ask what's inside. The less you know, the better. If you get caught, you can't give up what you don't know. That's why they picked you. You're quick and you know every shortcut in every back alley. You're the layer between the top [music] and the street. If the cops catch you, the chain breaks here. You take the fall and the bosses stay clean. A man you've never seen hands you a folded paper. The garrison back room. Don't run and don't look rushed. You take it and you walk at a steady natural pace. Just another kid on the street. Someone mentions a crew from the southside has been asking questions. New faces poking around and testing boundaries. That's not your concern. Not yet. You deliver the note. The man in the back room doesn't look at you. He doesn't thank you. That's how you know you did it right. Level four, petty thief. You hunt. Pockets, purses, an open window on a house where nobody's home. You take what you can get. The money isn't much, but it adds up. And every pound you bring in proves [music] you're useful. You're in a pub near the mill. It's crowded, loud, which means it's perfect. A man at the bar has had too much to drink. His coat hangs loose. You brush past. Your fingers find the pocket, get the coins, and you keep walking. He doesn't notice. Nobody notices. And that's the skill. Not just [music] taking things. Taking things without anyone knowing. Outside, you hear two men talking. Something about the Southside crew again. They robbed a bookie across the river. They took his whole week's profit. You frown. These guys are getting closer to your territory. But you've got coins in your pocket. and a cut to deliver. So, you keep moving. Level five, street robber. Being subtle is over. Now, you take what you want, and they know you're taking it. You step out of the shadow. You look them in the eye. Give it here. Most of them do. They've heard what happens to people who don't. A shopkeeper two streets over hasn't paid his weekly. You visit him with another lad from the crew. He sees you coming and his face goes white. I'll have it tomorrow. I swear. [music] You don't say anything. You just look at him. He finds the money. It's funny how that works. Walking back, you pass a pub where some of the boys are arguing. The southside crew hit another spot. Closer this time, three streets over. They're not just testing anymore. They're moving in. One of the enforcers spits on the ground. Let them come. You nod, but you notice the older [music] men aren't smiling. There's talk of a meeting, something big. The top man [music] is gathering people. You're not invited. Not yet. But you can feel the tension in the air. Something's coming. [music] Level six, hard man. When someone doesn't pay, you make them pay. When someone talks too much, you shut them up. When rivals test the edges of your territory, you push back hard enough that they don't try again. You've got scars, but you've given more. Your knuckles are calloused. Your nose has been broken twice. You walk into a room and conversations stop. Tonight, it's the Southside problem. You're in a back room with four other men. The operator is explaining what happened. The Southside crew didn't just rob the bookie. They beat him bloody and told him he works for them now. Find the ones who did it, someone says. Make sure they're found. You know what that means? Violence keeps this whole thing running. Respect, territory, money. None of it holds without men who can back it up. You've done this before. Rivals who thought they could [music] muscle in. Debtors who thought they could disappear. Each time you handled it, and each time the message spread, don't cross the peaky blinders. But this feels different. The Southside crew isn't a couple of opportunists. They're organized. They've got numbers. They've got their own hardmen. You crack your knuckles. Time to work. But as you leave, you catch a look between the operator and the top man. Something in their eyes you haven't seen before. Worry. Level seven. Operator. You run the systems that keep the money flowing. Illegal bedding, protection arrangements, moving stolen goods through people who know how to make things disappear. You know what comes in. You know what goes out. You know who's skimming and who's loyal. Numbers don't lie. And you read them better than anyone. Today you're counting last week's take from the betting shop. Good numbers. The raceh horses have been kind. Then a runner bursts in. They hit a shop. Broad daylight. Walked in. Cleaned it out. Walked out. You set down [music] your pencil. That shop is yours. Has been for years. They're here. You start calculating how much can you lose before the whole thing collapses? Which operations are vulnerable? Which men can you trust if things get bloody? You send for the hardmen. You send word to the top man. This is bigger than one robbery. The Southside crew has committed an act of war. Level eight. Top man. Every eye in the room is waiting for you to speak. You're in the back of the garrison, your pub, your territory. The operator sits across from you. The hard men line the walls. The whole operation, everyone who matters, packed into one room. You're not a king. You don't sit on a throne. You're just the man who settles disputes, picks targets, controls the takings, and decides who your crew stands with and against. In a world of loose alliances and shifting loyalties, that's power. The Southside crew has been pushing for weeks. Small moves at first. Now they've crossed the line. The shop robbery was a public [music] challenge. If you don't respond, you're finished. The shopkeepers stop paying because you can't protect them. The bookmakers make deals with someone else. Your own men start wondering if they backed the wrong [music] horse. You built this over years. You didn't inherit it. You earned it and you bled for it. You remember being a tag along once, following older boys through these same streets, waiting for your chance. You remember your first job as a runner. The note you carried felt like fire in your pocket. You remember your first real fight. The taste of blood in your mouth. The moment you realize [music] you weren't afraid, every rank, every rung of the ladder, you climbed them all. You've handled rivals before. Police raids that scattered the crew for weeks. Internal betrayals that nearly tore everything apart. Each time you found a way through. That's why these men trust you. That's why they're sitting here now waiting. One of the hard men speaks. Give the word. We'll handle it tonight. You shake your head. Rushing in is how you lose. You've seen it happen. You look around the room. 40 men who count on you. And you take a breath. We don't hit back blind. First, I want to know who their top man is, who he drinks with, who owes him, and who owes us that owes him. You stand up. I want to know where his money comes from, and where it goes. I want to know his weaknesses, his habits, his blind spots. You walk to the window. Outside, the [music] street is quiet. When we move, it ends. One night they don't recover. But we do it smart and we do it right. The room is silent, then slowly every man nods in agreement. These men chose to follow you. They chose you because you kept them alive and kept them earning. Because when everything went wrong, you found a way. Now you have to do it again. You look at the faces around the room. Runners who became thieves. Thieves [music] who became hardmen. Boys who started as tag alongs hovering at the edges and [music] now stand ready to fight for streets they've bled on. You built this. All of it. And you'll be damned if anyone takes it [music] from you. You don't know exactly how this ends. Nobody ever does. But you know one thing for certain. Nobody takes what's yours without a fight.

segments.viText: Có tin đồn về một cuộc họp, có chuyện gì đó lớn lao.

segments.text: The top man [music] is gathering people.
segments.viText: Người đàn ông hàng đầu [âm nhạc] đang tập hợp mọi người.

segments.text: You're not invited.
segments.viText: Bạn không được mời.

segments.text: Not yet.
segments.viText: Chưa.

segments.text: But you can feel the tension in the air.
segments.viText: Nhưng bạn có thể cảm nhận được sự căng thẳng trong không khí.

segments.text: Something's coming.
segments.viText: Có gì đó đang đến.

segments.text: [music] Level six, hard man.
segments.viText: [âm nhạc] Cấp độ sáu, người đàn ông cứng rắn.

segments.text: When someone doesn't pay, you make them pay.
segments.viText: Khi ai đó không trả tiền, bạn bắt họ phải trả tiền.

segments.text: When someone talks too much, you shut them up.
segments.viText: Khi ai đó nói quá nhiều, bạn hãy im lặng.

segments.text: When rivals test the edges of your territory, you push back hard enough that they don't try again.
segments.viText: Khi các đối thủ kiểm tra ranh giới lãnh thổ của bạn, bạn sẽ đẩy lùi đủ mạnh để họ không thử lại.

segments.text: You've got scars, but you've given more.
segments.viText: Bạn có những vết sẹo, nhưng bạn đã cho đi nhiều hơn thế.

segments.text: Your knuckles are calloused.
segments.viText: Các khớp ngón tay của bạn bị chai sạn.

segments.text: Your nose has been broken twice.
segments.viText: Mũi của bạn đã bị gãy hai lần.

segments.text: You walk into a room and conversations stop.
segments.viText: Bạn bước vào một căn phòng và cuộc trò chuyện dừng lại.

segments.text: Tonight, it's the Southside problem.
segments.viText: Tối nay, đó là vấn đề của Southside.

segments.text: You're in a back room with four other men.
segments.viText: Bạn đang ở phòng sau cùng với bốn người đàn ông khác.

segments.text: The operator is explaining what happened.
segments.viText: Người điều hành đang giải thích chuyện gì đã xảy ra.

segments.text: The Southside crew didn't just rob the bookie.
segments.viText: Nhóm Southside không chỉ cướp nhà cái.

segments.text: They beat him bloody and told him he works for them now.
segments.viText: Họ đánh anh ta đẫm máu và nói với anh ta rằng anh ta hiện đang làm việc cho họ.

segments.text: Find the ones who did it, someone says.
segments.viText: Tìm những người đã làm điều đó, có người nói.

segments.text: Make sure they're found.
segments.viText: Hãy chắc chắn rằng chúng được tìm thấy.

segments.text: You know what that means?
segments.viText: Bạn biết điều đó có nghĩa là gì không?

segments.text: Violence keeps this whole thing running.
segments.viText: Bạo lực khiến toàn bộ chuyện này tiếp tục diễn ra.

segments.text: Respect, territory, money.
segments.viText: Sự tôn trọng, lãnh thổ, tiền bạc.

segments.text: None of it holds without men who can back it up.
segments.viText: Sẽ không có chuyện gì xảy ra nếu không có người hỗ trợ.

segments.text: You've done this before.
segments.viText: Bạn đã từng làm điều này trước đây.

segments.text: Rivals who thought they could [music] muscle in.
segments.viText: Những đối thủ nghĩ rằng họ có thể [âm nhạc] tham gia.

segments.text: Debtors who thought they could disappear.
segments.viText: Những con nợ nghĩ rằng họ có thể biến mất.

segments.text: Each time you handled it, and each time the message spread, don't cross the peaky blinders.
segments.viText: Mỗi lần bạn xử lý nó và mỗi lần thông điệp được lan truyền, đừng vượt qua những rào cản cao điểm.

segments.text: But this feels different.
segments.viText: Nhưng điều này cảm thấy khác nhau.

segments.text: The Southside crew isn't a couple of opportunists.
segments.viText: Phi hành đoàn Southside không phải là một vài kẻ cơ hội.

segments.text: They're organized.
segments.viText: Họ có tổ chức.

segments.text: They've got numbers.
segments.viText: Họ có số.

segments.text: They've got their own hardmen.
segments.viText: Họ có những người cứng rắn của riêng họ.

segments.text: You crack your knuckles.
segments.viText: Bạn bẻ khớp ngón tay.

segments.text: Time to work.
segments.viText: Thời gian để làm việc.

segments.text: But as you leave, you catch a look between the operator and the top man.
segments.viText: Nhưng khi rời đi, bạn bắt gặp ánh nhìn giữa người điều hành và người đứng đầu.

segments.text: Something in their eyes you haven't seen before.
segments.viText: Có điều gì đó trong mắt họ mà bạn chưa từng thấy trước đây.

segments.text: Worry.
segments.viText: Lo lắng.

segments.text: Level seven.
segments.viText: Cấp bảy.

segments.text: Operator.
segments.viText: Người điều hành.

segments.text: You run the systems that keep the money flowing.
segments.viText: Bạn vận hành các hệ thống giúp tiền luôn chảy.

segments.text: Illegal bedding, protection arrangements, moving stolen goods through people who know how to make things disappear.
segments.viText: Chăn ga gối đệm bất hợp pháp, bố trí bảo vệ, vận chuyển đồ ăn trộm thông qua những người biết cách làm cho đồ đạc biến mất.

segments.text: You know what comes in.
segments.viText: Bạn biết điều gì sẽ xảy ra.

segments.text: You know what goes out.
segments.viText: Bạn biết những gì đi ra ngoài.

segments.text: You know who's skimming and who's loyal.
segments.viText: Bạn biết ai đang lướt qua và ai trung thành.

segments.text: Numbers don't lie.
segments.viText: Những con số không nói dối.

segments.text: And you read them better than anyone.
segments.viText: Và bạn đọc chúng tốt hơn bất cứ ai.

segments.text: Today you're counting last week's take from the betting shop.
segments.viText: Hôm nay bạn đang đếm số tiền thu được của tuần trước từ cửa hàng cá cược.

segments.text: Good numbers.
segments.viText: Những con số tốt.

segments.text: The raceh horses have been kind.
segments.viText: Những con ngựa đua rất tốt bụng.

segments.text: Then a runner bursts in.
segments.viText: Sau đó một người chạy xông vào.

segments.text: They hit a shop.
segments.viText: Họ tấn công một cửa hàng.

segments.text: Broad daylight.
segments.viText: Ánh sáng ban ngày rộng rãi.

segments.text: Walked in.
segments.viText: Bước vào.

segments.text: Cleaned it out.
segments.viText: Làm sạch nó ra.

segments.text: Walked out.
segments.viText: Bước ra ngoài.

segments.text: You set down [music] your pencil.
segments.viText: Bạn đặt [âm nhạc] cây bút chì của bạn xuống.

segments.text: That shop is yours.
segments.viText: Cửa hàng đó là của bạn.

segments.text: Has been for years.
segments.viText: Đã nhiều năm rồi.

segments.text: They're here.
segments.viText: Họ ở đây.

segments.text: You start calculating how much can you lose before the whole thing collapses?
segments.viText: Bạn bắt đầu tính toán mình có thể mất bao nhiêu trước khi toàn bộ sự việc sụp đổ?

segments.text: Which operations are vulnerable?
segments.viText: Những hoạt động nào dễ bị tổn thương?

segments.text: Which men can you trust if things get bloody?
segments.viText: Bạn có thể tin tưởng người đàn ông nào nếu mọi chuyện trở nên đẫm máu?

segments.text: You send for the hardmen.
segments.viText: Bạn gửi cho những người cứng rắn.

segments.text: You send word to the top man.
segments.viText: Bạn gửi lời tới người đứng đầu.

segments.text: This is bigger than one robbery.
segments.viText: Chuyện này còn lớn hơn một vụ cướp.

segments.text: The Southside crew has committed an act of war.
segments.viText: Phi hành đoàn Southside đã thực hiện một hành động chiến tranh.

segments.text: Level eight.
segments.viText: Cấp tám.

segments.text: Top man.
segments.viText: Người đàn ông hàng đầu.

segments.text: Every eye in the room is waiting for you to speak.
segments.viText: Mọi con mắt trong phòng đều đang chờ đợi bạn lên tiếng.

segments.text: You're in the back of the garrison, your pub, your territory.
segments.viText: Bạn đang ở phía sau đồn trú, quán rượu của bạn, lãnh thổ của bạn.

segments.text: The operator sits across from you.
segments.viText: Người điều hành ngồi đối diện với bạn.

segments.text: The hard men line the walls.
segments.viText: Những người đàn ông cứng rắn xếp hàng trên tường.

segments.text: The whole operation, everyone who matters, packed into one room.
segments.viText: Toàn bộ hoạt động, tất cả những người quan trọng, dồn vào một phòng.

segments.text: You're not a king.
segments.viText: Bạn không phải là một vị vua.

segments.text: You don't sit on a throne.
segments.viText: Bạn không ngồi trên ngai vàng.

segments.text: You're just the man who settles disputes, picks targets, controls the takings, and decides who your crew stands with and against.
segments.viText: Bạn chỉ là người giải quyết tranh chấp, chọn mục tiêu, kiểm soát doanh thu và quyết định phe của bạn ủng hộ và chống lại ai.

segments.text: In a world of loose alliances and shifting loyalties, that's power.
segments.viText: Trong một thế giới của những liên minh lỏng lẻo và lòng trung thành đang thay đổi, đó chính là sức mạnh.

segments.text: The Southside crew has been pushing for weeks.
segments.viText: Nhóm Southside đã nỗ lực nhiều tuần nay.

segments.text: Small moves at first.
segments.viText: Những chuyển động nhỏ lúc đầu.

segments.text: Now they've crossed the line.
segments.viText: Bây giờ họ đã vượt quá giới hạn.

segments.text: The shop robbery was a public [music] challenge.
segments.viText: Vụ cướp cửa hàng là một thử thách [âm nhạc] công khai.

segments.text: If you don't respond, you're finished.
segments.viText: Nếu bạn không trả lời, bạn đã xong.

segments.text: The shopkeepers stop paying because you can't protect them.
segments.viText: Những người bán hàng ngừng trả tiền vì bạn không thể bảo vệ họ.

segments.text: The bookmakers make deals with someone else.
segments.viText: Các nhà cái thực hiện giao dịch với người khác.

segments.text: Your own men start wondering if they backed the wrong [music] horse.
segments.viText: Người của bạn bắt đầu tự hỏi liệu họ có ủng hộ con ngựa [âm nhạc] sai hay không.

segments.text: You built this over years.
segments.viText: Bạn đã xây dựng nó trong nhiều năm.

segments.text: You didn't inherit it.
segments.viText: Bạn đã không thừa kế nó.

segments.text: You earned it and you bled for it.
segments.viText: Bạn kiếm được nó và bạn đổ máu vì nó.

segments.text: You remember being a tag along once, following older boys through these same streets, waiting for your chance.
segments.viText: Bạn nhớ mình đã từng đi theo một người, đi theo những chàng trai lớn tuổi hơn qua những con phố này, chờ đợi cơ hội.

segments.text: You remember your first job as a runner.
segments.viText: Bạn nhớ công việc đầu tiên của bạn là một Á hậu.

segments.text: The note you carried felt like fire in your pocket.
segments.viText: Bức thư bạn mang theo như lửa đốt trong túi.

segments.text: You remember your first real fight.
segments.viText: Bạn nhớ cuộc chiến thực sự đầu tiên của bạn.

segments.text: The taste of blood in your mouth.
segments.viText: Vị máu trong miệng.

segments.text: The moment you realize [music] you weren't afraid, every rank, every rung of the ladder, you climbed them all.
segments.viText: Khoảnh khắc bạn nhận ra [âm nhạc] bạn không sợ hãi, mọi cấp bậc, mọi nấc thang, bạn đã leo lên tất cả.

segments.text: You've handled rivals before.
segments.viText: Bạn đã xử lý các đối thủ trước đây.

segments.text: Police raids that scattered the crew for weeks.
segments.viText: Các cuộc đột kích của cảnh sát khiến thủy thủ đoàn phải phân tán trong nhiều tuần.

segments.text: Internal betrayals that nearly tore everything apart.
segments.viText: Sự phản bội nội tâm gần như xé tan mọi thứ.

segments.text: Each time you found a way through.
segments.viText: Mỗi lần bạn tìm thấy một cách để vượt qua.

segments.text: That's why these men trust you.
segments.viText: Đó là lý do tại sao những người đàn ông này tin tưởng bạn.

segments.text: That's why they're sitting here now waiting.
segments.viText: Đó là lý do tại sao họ đang ngồi đây chờ đợi.

segments.text: One of the hard men speaks.
segments.viText: Một trong những người đàn ông cứng rắn lên tiếng.

segments.text: Give the word.
segments.viText: Đưa ra lời nói.

segments.text: We'll handle it tonight.
segments.viText: Chúng ta sẽ giải quyết nó tối nay.

segments.text: You shake your head.
segments.viText: Bạn lắc đầu.

segments.text: Rushing in is how you lose.
segments.viText: Lao vào là bạn thua cuộc.

segments.text: You've seen it happen.
segments.viText: Bạn đã thấy nó xảy ra.

segments.text: You look around the room.
segments.viText: Bạn nhìn quanh phòng.

segments.text: 40 men who count on you.
segments.viText: 40 người đàn ông trông cậy vào bạn.

segments.text: And you take a breath.
segments.viText: Và bạn hít một hơi.

segments.text: We don't hit back blind.
segments.viText: Chúng tôi không đánh trả mù quáng.

segments.text: First, I want to know who their top man is, who he drinks with, who owes him, and who owes us that owes him.
segments.viText: Đầu tiên, tôi muốn biết người đứng đầu của họ là ai, anh ta uống rượu với ai, ai nợ anh ta và ai nợ chúng ta và ai nợ anh ta.

segments.text: You stand up.
segments.viText: Bạn đứng lên.

segments.text: I want to know where his money comes from, and where it goes.
segments.viText: Tôi muốn biết tiền của anh ấy đến từ đâu và đi đâu.

segments.text: I want to know his weaknesses, his habits, his blind spots.
segments.viText: Tôi muốn biết điểm yếu, thói quen, điểm mù của anh ấy.

segments.text: You walk to the window.
segments.viText: Bạn bước tới cửa sổ.

segments.text: Outside, the [music] street is quiet.
segments.viText: Bên ngoài, con phố [âm nhạc] yên tĩnh.

segments.text: When we move, it ends.
segments.viText: Khi chúng ta di chuyển, nó kết thúc.

segments.text: One night they don't recover.
segments.viText: Một đêm họ không hồi phục.

segments.text: But we do it smart and we do it right.
segments.viText: Nhưng chúng tôi làm điều đó một cách thông minh và chúng tôi làm đúng.

segments.text: The room is silent, then slowly every man nods in agreement.
segments.viText: Căn phòng im lặng, rồi dần dần mọi người đều gật đầu đồng ý.

segments.text: These men chose to follow you.
segments.viText: Những người đàn ông này đã chọn đi theo bạn.

segments.text: They chose you because you kept them alive and kept them earning.
segments.viText: Họ chọn bạn vì bạn đã giúp họ sống sót và giúp họ kiếm tiền.

segments.text: Because when everything went wrong, you found a way.
segments.viText: Bởi vì khi mọi thứ không như ý muốn, bạn đã tìm ra cách.

segments.text: Now you have to do it again.
segments.viText: Bây giờ bạn phải làm lại.

segments.text: You look at the faces around the room.
segments.viText: Bạn nhìn vào những khuôn mặt xung quanh phòng.

segments.text: Runners who became thieves.
segments.viText: Những người chạy bộ đã trở thành kẻ trộm.

segments.text: Thieves [music] who became hardmen.
segments.viText: Kẻ trộm [âm nhạc] đã trở thành người cứng rắn.

segments.text: Boys who started as tag alongs hovering at the edges and [music] now stand ready to fight for streets they've bled on.
segments.viText: Những chàng trai ban đầu chỉ là những người gắn thẻ lơ lửng ở rìa và [âm nhạc] giờ đã sẵn sàng chiến đấu để giành lấy những con phố mà họ đã đổ máu.

segments.text: You built this.
segments.viText: Bạn đã xây dựng cái này.

segments.text: All of it.
segments.viText: Tất cả đều như vậy.

segments.text: And you'll be damned if anyone takes it [music] from you.
segments.viText: Và bạn sẽ bị nguyền rủa nếu có ai lấy nó [âm nhạc] từ bạn.

segments.text: You don't know exactly how this ends.
segments.viText: Bạn không biết chính xác việc này kết thúc như thế nào.

segments.text: Nobody ever does.
segments.viText: Không ai từng làm vậy.

segments.text: But you know one thing for certain.
segments.viText: Nhưng bạn biết chắc một điều.

segments.text: Nobody takes what's yours without a fight.
segments.viText: Không ai lấy những gì của bạn mà không đấu tranh.
